title: Orthogonal projection onto a 2-plane in an orthonormal frame
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2, and a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0. Then for every x ∈ ℝ^P the orthogonal projection of x onto Q is Q.starProjection x = ⟨x, a⟩a + ⟨x, e⟩e.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → ∀ x : Euclid P, Q.starProjection x = inner ℝ x a • a + inner ℝ x e • e
